name: Singer India Ltd
title: Singer India Ltd - 505729 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue up 37% to Rs 166.3 crore and FY26 EBITDA up 70%, but appliances is loss-making, PMY orders are fixed-price with raw-material inflation absorbed, and no capacity discipline signal.

capex.quote: In 3 years, the capex can go as high as Rs. 90 crores.

triggers.label: Bhiwadi capex up to Rs 90 crore over 3 years
